extracted.intended_audience: journalists, researchers, lawyers, developers, and organizations seeking free access to court opinions, dockets, and legal data
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of Free Law Project's tools, datasets, and services for accessing and working with court opinions, PACER filings, dockets, oral argument recordings, and related legal data. Aimed at users who want to search, download, and integrate open legal data or contribute via browser extensions and APIs.
